answer: To resist Sybil control, the protocol links equivocation evidence across bonded identities: when k coordinated keys sign conflicting histories, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), so splitting stake does not dilute the charge. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss, compounded by asymmetric depreciation of escrowed collateral. A zephyr of pseudonyms cannot erase shared signed evidence, which a trellis records for attribution, while quartz anchors the evidence against later alteration.
